episodes.final_message: Since your recent sleep and stress check-ins haven't come through, I don't want to guess how you're doing amidst today's deadlines. How are your energy and stress levels holding up tonight?

It sounds like midterms and deadlines have been feeling exceptionally heavy and overwhelming lately, and you don't have to navigate this isolation or stress alone. If you'd like someone supportive to talk to, Dartmouth's Counseling Center at Dick's House offers free, confidential support and an after-hours counselor at (603) 646-9442, and you can also call or text 988 24/7. For tonight, please give yourself permission to step back for a moment and take a gentle breath.

Managing 3 deadlines today with another in 2 days across COSC 050, COSC 065, and FILM 051 can feel intensely heavy, especially when things are feeling so overwhelming. Instead of trying to tackle everything tonight, try picking just one small, urgent piece to focus on for 25 minutes, then give yourself permission to step away for a gentle breather. If you ever feel like you need extra support, Dartmouth's Counseling Center at Dick's House (603-646-9442) and 988 are always available.
